name: Model Metadata Standard
blurb: The full record kept for every model: release and licence, parameters and architecture, context and training data, distribution, pricing and performance, and safety.

reading.body:
This collection tracks six fields sourced from the Hugging Face Hub for every model, model ID and page, licence, downloads and likes, release date, modality, and parameters, plus four more fields sourced from the OpenRouter catalogue specifically for models available through an API.

Four categories of information are explicitly excluded, and each has a stated reason rather than being simply omitted. Training data is excluded because most publishers do not disclose it and the site does not guess. Benchmark scores are excluded because self-reported numbers are not independently verifiable, with leaderboards linked from the research section instead. Safety evaluations are excluded because no consistent free primary source exists across publishers yet. Valuation-grade adoption claims are excluded because downloads are the only adoption number a free primary source actually carries.

That the parameters field is sourced specifically from safetensors metadata, and only tracked where a publisher ships that metadata with a declared count, is the same constraint that limits the small language models collection elsewhere in this site to models that publish a parameter count, meaning this standard's sourcing choice directly shapes which models can be classified as small anywhere else on the site.
